apps.name: Bite
apps.subtitle: Calories without the subscription
apps.localizedDescription: Search, scan a barcode, or snap your plate. Bitey keeps you company.

versions.localizedDescription: Each food's protein, carbs, and fat now show as color chips (💪 🍞 🥑) matching the macro tiles, instead of P/C/F letters.

Tap any food to edit grams, time, or day. Quick add calories. Add food to past days from History. Save meals and log them in one tap. Tap + on the widget to log without opening Bite. History gets a 7-day chart, weekly average, and streaks.

Your food log now stays put through updates, with an automatic backup in your iPhone's Keychain. Days that seemed to vanish after the widget update come back. Plus the playful redesign, Bitey, and macro rings.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bite uses the camera to scan barcodes and photograph your meals.
